name: Aftermath's two charges reach both Scrap Shots (#4642)
contract: Aftermath (707260 driver, 707261 TinkerFinite buff) reads 'your next 2 Scrap Shots ... cast faster and deal more damage'. Its ProcCharges is patched to 2 in AscensionTinkerContracts.cpp, and aura_ascension_tinker_lifecycle::Apply() calls SetUsingCharges(false) so the custom Spend() path (AscensionTinker.cpp) is meant to be the sole consumer, matching the native workaround in Player::RemoveSpellMods that skips auras carrying a live spell_proc entry -- 707261 has none (ProcFlags forced to 0), so that skip does not fire for it. But Aura::SetCharges() unconditionally recomputes m_isUsingCharges = (charges != 0), so the first Spend() decrement (2 -> 1) flips IsUsingCharges() back to true, reopening the native spellmod-charge path (Player::RemoveSpellMods -> DropCharge) for 707261's own SPELLMOD_DAMAGE/SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME effects on Scrap Shot 500549 (SpellClassMask 16 matches SpellFamilyFlags[0] 16), on top of the script's own decrement -- consuming both charges before the second Scrap Shot ever sees the buff. A fixture-applied Aftermath aura goes through the same Apply()/Select()/Snapshot()/Finish()/Spend() path as a real Sticky-Bomb-driven grant, so casting Scrap Shot twice against a real target exercises the exact native RemoveSpellMods interaction the fix closes: after the fix each real cast spends exactly one charge, and the 25 percent SPELLMOD_DAMAGE bonus (EffectBasePoints[1]=24 with DieSides 1 resolving to +25 per SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue's DieSides==1 case, on 707261, op 0 base 1000 -> 1250) stays live for both Scrap Shots.

steps.label: Aftermath's damage bonus is live before any Scrap Shot
Aftermath survives the first Scrap Shot with one charge left
Aftermath is still applied after the first Scrap Shot
The damage bonus still applies for the second Scrap Shot
Aftermath's second charge is spent by the second Scrap Shot
Both Scrap Shots actually landed on the target
